result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk and sidewalks, but is dominated by heavy vehicle traffic, including a large tanker truck that creates significant visual obstructions. The environment lacks visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands, increasing exposure on this multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tanker truck is positioned within the intersection, completely blocking the line of sight between pedestrians at the curb and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground, occupying the roadway and intersection area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: While a crosswalk is present, there are no visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signal poles on the right and across the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing their visibility in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane roadway with a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk on the left side. result.summary: The intersection is equipped with a marked zebra crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile paving. However, the multi-lane roadway lacks a median refuge, and parked vehicles near the intersection may create sightline obstructions for crossing pedestrians.
